testing_warning: This build is published so the website, release manifest, downloads, checksums, and Android install path can be tested. It is not yet confirmed as the first fully working wallet release. Do not use it for meaningful funds.

copy.hero_title: Pearl Wallet for Android is being tested.
copy.hero_summary: PRL Wallet is a noncustodial Android wallet project for Pearl. This page is wired to release metadata so every build can update the version, date, download link, hash, changelog, and status without editing the homepage.
copy.above_fold_note: Release data is populated from JSON now and XML as fallback. CI/manual builds emit both.

distribution.shared_hosting_mirror: downstream mirror for higher public traffic, not the canonical release authority

features.title: Manifest-driven landing page
features.summary: The homepage reads release metadata at runtime and fills version, dates, download URLs, hashes, status, features, and changelog.

features.title: Direct signed APK distribution
features.summary: The tester APK is distributed from the site while app-store distribution is not active.

features.title: Checksum verification
features.summary: The published SHA-256 is displayed beside the APK download so testers can confirm file integrity before installing.

features.title: SPV wallet recovery
features.summary: Import recovery, genesis birthday handling, and full balance discovery are under active repair and verification.

features.title: Explorer preliminary balance
features.summary: The app can display a provisional explorer balance for the visible receive address while local sync catches up. Full HD-wallet discovery remains a separate verification concern.

features.title: Local canonical deployment
features.summary: The local nginx-ui deployment is the canonical site. Shared hosting can mirror it later for traffic, but the local release root remains authoritative.

known_limitations: Do not use tester APKs for meaningful funds unless a release is explicitly marked production-ready.
Explorer preliminary balance is single-address and provisional until local wallet recovery is complete.
Manual builds and CI builds must emit this manifest shape; index.html must not be hand-edited for release data.

notes: # Release Notes — v1.133.05015
**MANDATORY UPGRADE — Salted Noise-seed hardfork (mainnet block 99,000).**
At build time the chain stood at height 98,999: the fork activates at the very next block.
Older releases (engine pearl-wallet-v2.0.0) cannot validate V3 certificates and stop following
the chain at height 99,000 — balances and transactions freeze at the fork until upgraded.
This build installs as a normal upgrade over v1.124 and earlier (same production signing key).
## What's new

- Splash engine identity now DERIVED from the vendor lock at build time (no hardcodes anywhere): Gradle reads the newest UPSTREAM-VENDOR.lock tag into BuildConfig.ENGINE_VERSION, and the Go bridge var is stamped via -ldflags from the same lock (GLM-4.7 crush-coded). Splash renders
- **Engine upgraded to upstream `pearl-wallet-v2.0.5`** (commit `950adc85`, published
2026-08-11) — 46 upstream commits over the previous v2.0.0 base:
- **Salted noise-seed hardfork support (V3 certificates)** — the wallet keeps validating and
following the chain through mainnet height 99,000.
- Dense-only softfork (h=91,630) and rank-penalty softfork (h=96,251) validation rules.
- Wallet sync robustness: orphaned-block rollback after unapplied reorgs; RPC client timeout
and stale-daemon cleanup fixes; RPC server/client + TLS overhaul.
- SPV peer discovery via DNS seeders (`seeder1..3.pearlresearch.ai`) with custom-peer option
preserved.
- Wire hardening: script-count buffer validation, proof serialize round-trip checks, bounded
mempool RBF traversal.
- Local engine patches preserved: reconnect-safe `SynchronizeRPC` + `DisconnectRPC` (regression
test passing) and per-ABI Android zk-pow FFI linkage.
- Carried from this lineage since the v1.124 build on devices: AD-W1 balance-widget enlargement
(3×2 default + balance autosize, WGT-6) and widget theming de-drift to the lordofpearls.xyz
canonical tokens (WGT-7).
- Build tooling (GLM-4.7 crush-coded): NDK auto-discovery in `build-zkpow-android.sh`,
`GOTOOLCHAIN` operator-overridable default in `build-release.sh`, newest-vendor-lock
selection in `check-upstream-wallet-release.sh`.
## Provenance
- Vendored pristine tree: `vendored-in-code/pearlresearchai/wallet-go-v2.0.5/` +
`wallet-go-v2.0.5.UPSTREAM-VENDOR.lock`; substitution record `DOCS/UPSTREAM-v2.0.5-DELTA.md`
(CHECKLIST Phase 12).
## Known issues
- Device verification of a live sync across the 99,000 boundary is pending; install
`pearl-wallet-android-v1.133.05015-release-signed.apk` and confirm header sync passes 99,000.
- Release builds are signed with the same production key; in-place upgrades work. If switching
from a debug/dev build, uninstall first.
